name: serde-default-key-byte-stability
description: When modeling a new config key in a byte-stable format contract (seeds .seeds/config.yaml vs sd-0.5.15 which enforces additionalProperties:false and is differentially byte-compared), serialize the field with serde(default, skip_serializing_if=<is_default>) so the default value never leaks into rewritten configs; Store::save rewrites config.yaml via to_yaml, and an always-serialized default key would break reference compat (seeds-5b36).

title: CLI verb family + loud-break policy post-cutover
rationale: Evidence (fabro-2919 replace-slip, 2026-10-14 consumer census: 8/8 live description-write mandates are append/amend-intent, zero stdout parsers) showed the implicit-SET description flags were the dominant destruction path; loud unknown-flag errors make CLI breaks safe while the format freeze (ADR-0023) still holds for .seeds/ records.

description: git merge zweier neu geschriebener .seeds-JSONL-Stores interleave die Zeilen: der Merge von origin/main (37 Commits) hinterliess 2 duplicate ids (seeds-d54c, seeds-15cf) + 1 status/closedAt-Inkonsistenz; seeds show/list/stats lagen dadurch daneben (d54c simultaneously open und closed).
resolution: Nach JEDEM Merge, der .seeds/ beruehrt: seeds doctor pruefen, dann 'seeds dedupe --write' (newest-updatedAt gewinnt, Ties: spaetere Zeile) und 'seeds sync'. Beide Dups wurden korrekt aufgeloest (d54c -> closed-Record, 15cf -> Record mit closedAt); doctor 12/12 gruen. Root-Cause-Fix ist seeds-e29a (canonical-order write mode).

name: canonical-write-order-git-merge-safe
description: Git-native JSONL-Store: kanonische Ordnung beim Speichern (zeilenweise nach id byteweise sortiert, Pro-Rekord-Zeile unveraendert) macht Cross-Branch-Appends zeilendisjunkt und damit git-merge-sauber (seeds-e29a). Residual: gleiche Record-Edits beidseits konfliktieren weiterhin (Dedupe-Rezeptur fabro-4cfc pt.3) — bewusst nicht geloest. Reader folgen Datei-Reihenfolge (auch sd 0.5.15), also Divergenz nur in reihenfolge-abhaengigen Outputs: Differentials auf Record-Set-Vergleich in Creation-Order umstellen, nicht auf Byte-Paritaet der Datei.

name: native-checks-conditional-for-diff-parity
description: Referenz-Differential-Paritaet beim Hinzufuegen nativer Checks: der Check nur bei Fund einschliessen (conditional, komplett weglassen wenn clean) haelt Healthy-Store-Byte-Paritaet — differential_doctor_matches_sd bleibt gruen waehrend write-safety (stray .*.tmp, held .lock) nativ dazukommt (seeds-36cd). Status-Sonden wie die Writer-Lock-Probe duerfen in --fix-Modus nicht laufen: der Command-Layer haelt den Lock selbst.

seeds list vs seeds show disagreed on a seed's status (list showed open, show showed closed): store carried DUPLICATE records for the same id (one open, one closed). seeds doctor reports 'duplicate id(s)'; --fix dedupes keeping newest updatedAt — which can keep the OPEN duplicate and eat a close. When a supposedly-done seed reappears as open, run seeds doctor first; after dedupe verify the closed state survived and re-close with a --reason referencing the original close if not.
resolution: doctor --fix deduped; d2c5's closed record was newer and won, b657's open duplicate was newer so the close was re-applied manually with --reason (2026-11-04)

name: differential-promote-reference-binary-name
description: The differential battery promotes the reference side's self-referential 'sd ' command prefixes to 'seeds ' before every stdout/stderr/store comparison (promote_reference / promote_reference_json in tests/differential.rs, seeds-9667) — shipped strings name THIS binary (seeds-3791 cutover law). When adding new hint strings that name the binary, write 'seeds <cmd>' directly; never pin reference sd wording. Same law as mulch's batteries promoting the ml side.
